title: 📊 Daily Report: Thu Nov 12, 2026
text:
The swing book closed at $17,886.44, up $28.02 on the day. For the week it's up $67.52 against Monday's base: the strategies are up $49.09 and CORE QQQ is up $18.43. Since the merge the book is down 10.66% ($2,134.30), while Indy (the SPY buy-and-hold benchmark) is down 2.76% ($551.63), so we're trailing by $1,582.67.

No strategy bot traded today — the gate was open, but no setup met the entry rules. CORE QQQ bought back in this morning (15.28 shares) after the trend filter flipped on (prior close 690.38 vs the 200-day at 680.65); it now holds $10,512, or 59% of the book. Four positions remain open (Trek in ACN and VRSN, Sunny in MPC and PSX). Sunny is the only active bot; Trek and Rota have no edge, and the rest are benched. Idle cash earned $0.66 in interest today.

Research's analyst note for today:
- Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned (CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO). NVDA fell nearly 12% early and closed about 4% lower; the S&P, Dow and Nasdaq each closed down about 0.3-0.4%.
- Rotation, not panic: AMD, AVGO, GOOGL and AMZN rose, energy gained for a 4th day as oil rose on Iran comments, and the 10-yr stayed above 5%. NBIS, CRWV, IREN and MU slid.
- Our calls: the AI-hardware avoid held up (NBIS about -15% midday). LLY opened higher on its China pill approval but closed about -0.7%. We passed on TTEK's gap, and it faded from $41.50 to $39.43.
- After hours: CSCO up about 5% on a beat and raise (AI hyperscaler revenue target now $9B); AMAT beat but traded mixed. We log CSCO only if the gain holds into Friday's close.
- Next: PPI Friday; NVDA earnings 11/17; HD, TGT, WMT next week; Anthropic IPO talk. The chip avoid stays through 11/18.

Floor: https://blackk92.github.io/tendies-and-dip/

Claude impact: no advice batches yet.
